verdict.rationale: The only command-line evidence is the official `npx @portkey-ai/gateway` command, which runs the open-source gateway locally with a single command. That is a first-party command-line entry point, but it is a server launcher, not a CLI for managing or operating Portkey. Missing for 10: a documented CLI for managing configs, keys, logs, prompts or the model catalog; CLI reference docs; agent- or AI-native workflow support; independent or hands-on corroboration.
